title: GitHub - Alpharotationlab/US-ETF-Rotation-Model: Open-source ...
snippet: Open-source ETF rotation framework for the US market. This repository provides a simplified, research-grade implementation of a momentum-based ETF rotation strategy combined with a 200-day moving average trend filter, designed for quantitative research, backtesting, and educational purposes.
excerpt: Title: GitHub - Alpharotationlab/US-ETF-Rotation-Model: Open-source ETF rotation model for the US market. Combines momentum ranking with a 200-day MA trend filter. Includes backtesting tools (2019–2026), yfinance-based data pipeline, and basic risk metrics. Built for quantitative research and education.
